name: 60827 · Riverdale, IL
findings: ZIP 60827 (Riverdale) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60827 (Riverdale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60827 (Riverdale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
